    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    call 0x446220
    pushfd
    pop dword ptr [ebp - 0x2C]
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x1C], eax
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x30], ecx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x34], edx

    xor edx, edx

    jns live_overflow_ready
    mov edx, eax

live_overflow_ready:
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x20], edx
    cmp dword ptr [ebp - 0x20], 0
    jle live_finish
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x10]
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x14]
    jge live_finish

    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    push 0
    push dword ptr [eax + 0x38]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    push dword ptr [ecx + 0x132C0]
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je live_finish
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    jne live_finish

    push 0
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x20]
    push eax
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    call 0x639cf5

live_finish:
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x1C]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x30]
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x34]
    pop edi
    pop esi
    pop ebx
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x2C]
    popfd
    mov esp, ebp

dead_stack:
    push ebp
    mov ebp, esp
    sub esp, 0x08
    push ebx
    push esi
    push edi
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x04], ecx
    mov dword ptr [ebp - 0x08], ebx
    cmp dword ptr [ecx + 0x60], 0
    jle dead_finish

    push 0
    push dword ptr [ecx + 0x38]
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]
    push dword ptr [eax + 0x132C0]
    mov ecx, eax
    call 0x5a3fd0
    test eax, eax
    je dead_finish
    cmp eax, dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    jne dead_finish

    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    push eax
    call 0x639d80
    test eax, eax
    jle dead_finish

    push 0
    push eax
    push dword ptr [ebp - 0x04]
    mov ecx, dword ptr [ebp - 0x08]

dead_finish:

    pop ebx

tail_cure:

components.name: target_resolver_gate
components.assembly:
target_resolver_gate:
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x08]
    cmp edx, 0x25
    jne resolver_original

    push ecx
    mov eax, dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    lea edx, [eax * 8]
    sub edx, eax
    shl edx, 4
    lea ecx, [edx + ecx + 0x1C4]
    mov eax, 0x4e7230
    call eax
    test eax, eax
    jnz resolver_return_living
    pop ecx

    cmp dword ptr [ebp + 0x18], 0
    jne resolver_zero
    mov edx, dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    cmp edx, dword ptr [ecx + 0x132C0]
    jne resolver_zero
    mov eax, dword ptr [ecx + edx * 4 + 0x53CC]
    test eax, eax
    jz resolver_zero
    mov eax, dword ptr [eax + 0x1A]
    cmp eax, 0x19
    je resolver_corpse
    cmp eax, 0xAA
    jne resolver_zero

resolver_corpse:
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x18]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x10]
    push dword ptr [ebp + 0x0C]
    mov eax, 0x5a3fd0
    call eax
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_return_living:
    add esp, 4
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_zero:
    xor eax, eax
    pop ebp
    ret 0x14

resolver_original:
